content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Select a Method - PayLink ## slug: select-method-paylink-multilingual-support ## seoTitle: Select a Method - PayLink ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Data Dictionary The {{variable.Product_PayLink}}’s field labels, button text, and checkout screen text will be written in the language selected in the {{variable.Field_Transact_PayLinkDispLang}} field on the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record. If the {{variable.Field_Transact_PayLinkDispLang}} field is blank, the labels, button text, and text on the checkout screen will default to English. The translations on the {{variable.Product_PayLink}} can also be overridden by using the {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}}. Use the instructions below to create a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} from the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record. ### Required Licenses and Permission Sets To use the Data Dictionary feature, you must have a Blackthorn Payments license, as well as access to the following fields: * Create/Read/Update - Data Dictionary Group * Create/Read/Update - Data Dictionary Entry ### Supported Languages We do not currently support all languages. The following is a list of the languages we support. * Arabic * Chinese (Simplified) * Chinese (Traditional) * Czech * Danish * Dutch * Finnish * French * German * Haitian Creole * Hindi * Hmong * Hungarian * Indonesian * Italian * Japanese * Korean * Norwegian * Polish * Portuguese * Romanian * Russian * Somali * Spanish * Swedish * Thai * Turkish * Vietnamese ### One-to-One Relationships A {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} record contains three important fields: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}, {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}}, and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}}. In each {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} record, the fields interact as follows: * There can be only one value in the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} field. * Each {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} is associated only with one {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}. Creating a second line in the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} using the same {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} as the first line but with a different {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} will replace the first {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} with the new one. Example: * Line 1: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_CHECKOUT" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Checkout" * Line 2: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_CHECKOUT" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = “Proceed” * Result: The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see “Proceed.” ### Create a Data Dictionary Group If you want to override out-of-the-box values, the first step is to create a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} and populate it with {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntries}}. 1. In the App Launcher, enter and click “Data Dictionary Group.” 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. ![CreateDataDictionaryGroup_Object\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CreateDataDictionaryGroup_Object%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 4. Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictGrpName}}. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![CreateDataDictionaryGroup_New\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CreateDataDictionaryGroup_New%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 7. Click {{variable.button_new}} next to {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}}. ![CreateDataDictionaryGroup_NewEntry\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CreateDataDictionaryGroup_NewEntry%281%29.png){height="" width=""} 9. The {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_DataDictValu}} field contains the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}}, {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}}, and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}. Click the [PayLink Data Dictionary](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lOyDPI6pYG8wraGuQfM7Btu9KhvmhmsdnRQO4_CdPBk/edit?usp=sharing){target=`_blank`} (a Google document) for {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} information. 10. Here are few frequently used Data Dictionary values and their keys: * {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_TOTAL" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Total" * {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_INVOICE" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Invoice" * {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_BALANCE_PAID" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Balance Paid" * {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "MSG_PROCESSING_TRANSACTION" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Processing transaction..." * {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "MSG_AUTHORIZE_CREDIT_CARD_WITH_NAME" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "I authorize (XYZ) to charge my credit card." 11. Select the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} you'd like to change. 12. Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}. 13. Click **Add Row** to add additional entries or click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 14. Click **Back** to return to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} record. ![CreateDataDictionaryGroup_EntryKeyValue\(1\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/CreateDataDictionaryGroup_EntryKeyValue%281%29.png){height="" width=""} If you need to add additional keys to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}}, click the menu (upside down triangle) next to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}}. From there, click **Add Row** to add a new {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}. When you are done, click {{variable.Button_Save}} and **Back** to return to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}}. :::(Error) (USE CAPITAL LETTERS) In the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} field, use capital letters. ::: #### Example For this example, we will set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} = "German". Now, we can select any word or phrase to replace an action with. Set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_DUE_DATE“ and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = “Faelligkeitsdatum”. Make sure to use all capital letters for the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}}. ![DocuLink_DataDictionary_German_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/DocuLink_DataDictionary_German_1.png){height="" width=""} ![DocuLink_DataDict_German_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/DocuLink_DataDict_German_2.png){height="" width=""} ### Add a Data Dictionary Group to a PayLink Configuration 1. Open an existing {{variable.Object_PayLinkConfiguration}} record or create a new one. 2. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_PayLinkConfig_DataDictGr}} field. 3. Select a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}}. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Default Language ### Change the Default Language The following functionality has been added. * {{variable.Product_PayLink}} checkout will be displayed in the language selected on the {{variable.Object_PayLinkConfiguration}} record. * Labels will default to English if the {{variable.Field_PayLinkConfig_DispLangua}} field on the {{variable.Object_PayLinkConfiguration}} record is left blank. * The language on labels and buttons can be overwritten with a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} record containing the matching {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}}. * The date will be formatted based on the language selected on the {{variable.Object_PayLinkConfiguration}} record. If no language is selected, the date format will be based on the browser’s location. ### Translate a PayLink Configuration Record 1. Go to a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} record. 2. Click an existing {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayLinkConfi}} or create a new one. 3. Select a {{variable.Field_PayLinkConfig_DispLangua}}. 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ## Override a Specific Key If you are looking for a specific {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} you want to override but can't find it, click the {{variable.Field_Transaction_PayLink}} URL field, and swap the language in the domain with "debug". You will see the keys on a specific PayLink, or in other words, the debugged version of the PayLink with each field identified. See the images below to see how swapping "https://dev.paylink.blackthorn.io" with "https://dev.paylink.blackthorn.io/debug/" shows the keys. ### PayLink URL – Original ![PayLink URL DeBug_Before](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/PayLink%20URL%20DeBug_Before.png){height="" width=""} ### PayLink URL – Debug ![PayLink URL_DeBug_After](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/PayLink%20URL_DeBug_After.png){height="" width=""}
